name: Ryot
description: A self-hosted platform for tracking various facets of your life - media, fitness etc.

variables.name: Server - Admin Access Token
variables.description: An access token that can be used for admin operations.

variables.name: Server - Pro Key
variables.description: Key to activate pro features. If left blank, will default to community edition.

variables.name: Server - SMTP - Mailbox
variables.description: The mailbox format for sending emails.

variables.name: Server - SMTP - Host
variables.description: The SMTP host to send emails from.

variables.name: Server - SMTP - User
variables.description: The SMTP user to send emails from.

variables.name: Server - SMTP - Password
variables.description: The SMTP password to send emails from.

variables.name: UI - URL
variables.description: Used as the base URL when generating item links for the frontend.

variables.name: Security - Allow Registration
variables.description: Allow users to register for an account.

variables.name: Security - JWT Token Secret
variables.description: The secret used for generating JWT tokens.

variables.name: Security - Disable Local Auth
variables.description: Whether to disable local user authentication completely.

variables.name: Security - OIDC - Client ID
variables.description: The client ID for OIDC authentication.

variables.name: Security - OIDC - Client Secret
variables.description: The client secret for OIDC authentication.

variables.name: Security - OIDC - Issuer URL
variables.description: The issuer URL for OIDC authentication.

variables.name: Database - URL
variables.description: URL of the Postgres database

variables.name: File Storage - S3 - Access Key ID
variables.description: The access key ID for the S3 compatible file storage. Required to enable file storage.

variables.name: File Storage - S3 - Secret Access Key
variables.description: The secret access key for the S3 compatible file storage. Required to enable file storage.

variables.name: FIle Storage - S3 - URL
variables.description: The URL for the S3 compatible file storage. Required to enable file storage.

variables.name: File Storage - S3 - Region
variables.description: The region for the S3 compatible file storage. Required to enable file storage.

variables.name: File Storage - S3 - Bucket
variables.description: The bucket name for the S3 compatible file storage. Required to enable file storage.

variables.name: Media - Monitoring Length
variables.description: Number of days after which a media should be removed from the Monitoring collection.

variables.name: Anime/Manga - Anilist - Preferred Language
variables.description: The preferred language for Anilist data.

variables.name: Anime/Manga - MAL - Client ID
variables.description: The client ID issued by MAL.

variables.name: Audiobooks - Audible - Locale
variables.description: The locale for Audible data.

variables.name: Books - Google Books - API Key
variables.description: The API key issued by Google Books.

variables.name: Books - Google Books - Pass Raw Query
variables.description: Whether to pass the raw query string to the search API.

variables.name: Books - Hardcover - API Key
variables.description: The API key issued by Hardcover.

variables.name: Books - Openlibrary - Cover Image Size
variables.description: The size of the cover image to fetch from Openlibrary.

variables.name: Movies/Shows - TMDB - Access Token
variables.description: The access token issued by TMDB.

variables.name: Movies/Shows - TMDB - Locale
variables.description: The preferred language for TMDB data.

variables.name: Movies/Shows - TVDB - API Key
variables.description: The API key for the TVDB API.

variables.name: Podcasts - iTunes - Locale
variables.description: The locale for iTunes data.

variables.name: Podcasts - Listennotes - API Token
variables.description: The API token issued by Listennotes.

variables.name: Music - Spotify - Client ID
variables.description: The client ID for the Spotify API.

variables.name: Music - Spotify - Client Secret
variables.description: The client secret for the Spotify API.

variables.name: Video Games - IGDB - Image Size
variables.description: The size of the cover image to fetch from IGDB.

variables.name: Video Games - Twitch - Client ID
variables.description: The client ID issued by Twitch. Required to enable video games tracking.

variables.name: Video Games - Twitch - Client Secret
variables.description: The client secret issued by Twitch. Required to enable video games tracking.

variables.name: Video Games - GiantBomb - API Key
variables.description: The API key for the GiantBomb API.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: Internal port of the container. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Server - Backend Host
variables.description: The host address to bind the backend server to.

variables.name: Server - Backend Port
variables.description: The port number to bind the backend server to.

variables.name: Server - CORS Origins
variables.description: An array of URLs for CORS origins.

variables.name: Server - Disable Background Jobs
variables.description: Disable background jobs

variables.name: Server - Progress Update Threshold
variables.description: The hours in which a media can be marked as seen again for a user. This is used so that the same media can not be used marked as started when it has been already marked as seen in the last `n` hours.

variables.name: Server - Enable GraphQL Playground
variables.description: Enable the GraphQL playground

variables.name: Server - Enable Demo Mode
variables.description: Enable demo mode

variables.name: Server - Importer - Trakt Client ID
variables.description: The client ID for the Trakt importer. Required to enable Trakt importer.

variables.name: Server - Max File Size
variables.description: The maximum file size, in MB, for user uploads.

variables.name: Server - Startup Sleep
variables.description: The number of seconds to sleep before starting the server.

variables.name: UI - Dashboard Message
variables.description: A message to be displayed on the dashboard.

variables.name: UI - OIDC Button
variables.description: The button label for OIDC authentication.

variables.name: Security - User Token Validity
variables.description: The number of days till login authentication token is valid.

variables.name: Analytics - Disable Telemetry
variables.description: Opt out of telemetry metrics

variables.name: Analytics - Domain Names
variables.description: Comma separated list of domain names to provide in analytics

variables.name: Analytics - Script URL
variables.description: URL of the Umami analytics script. For example: https://umami.is/script.js

variables.name: Analytics - Website ID
variables.description: The website ID for Umami analytics

variables.name: Scheduler - Frequent Cron Jobs Schedule
variables.description: English expression for frequent cron tasks (syncing integrations, workout revisions). Uses https://github.com/kaplanelad/english-to-cron.

variables.name: Scheduler - Infrequent Cron Jobs Schedule
variables.description: English expression for infrequent cron jobs (cleaning up data, refreshing calendar). Uses https://github.com/kaplanelad/english-to-cron.

variables.name: Integrations - Sync Time
variables.description: Sync data from push and yank based integrations every `n` minutes.
